_comment: The letters of any tale's villain (Expansion 6 E.1; beats.villain.json): its plain letter, and the one made with what its spy stole ({token}, {token_of}, {companion}). Paragraphs split by a blank line; signed by the villain (the beat op `letter`).

villain_letter:
To the one who follows me,

I know your name now, and the road you took to {town}, and the inn where you slept. I tell you this so that you understand how little you are hidden.

This is not your quarrel. Go home while it is still a home to go to.

{villain}

To the stranger at {town},

You have been asking questions in my country. Every one of them has been answered to me before it was answered to you.

I am patient, and I am not cruel without need. Do not give me need.

{villain}

To the meddler,

I have watched you a while. You are brave, I think, and you are foolish, and the two so often go together.

There is nothing at {home} for you but an ending. Choose another road.

{villain}

To the one who will not leave,

I have let you walk where you like. Do not think it was because I could not stop you.

The next time I write, it will not be to you.

{villain}
villain_token_letter:
To {hero},

You will know this. {token_of} carried it, and does not carry it now, and never noticed my friend close enough to take it.

That is how close I can come. Think on it, the next time {token_of} lies down to sleep.

{villain}

To the one who sleeps so soundly,

I send back what I took, so that you will know it was taken. {token}, of {token_of}'s. A small thing. Next time it will not be small.

Go home, all of you, and keep each other close.

{villain}

To {hero}, and to {token_of},

I have held {token} in my hand, and through it I have seen a little of you both: your fears, and the names you call out in the night.

I could have kept it. I would rather you knew.

{villain}

To {hero},

{token_of} has a careless way with small things. {token} was easy to take. A throat would not be much harder.

I do not say this to frighten you. I say it so that you will choose well.

{villain}
